customManagers.description: Track the zizmor CLI pin in the local pre-commit hook (`uvx zizmor@X.Y.Z`) as zizmorcore/zizmor, so it lands in the org Zizmor group and moves in lockstep with the zizmor.yml `version:` pin and the zizmor-action release. The org :gha preset only covers .githooks/pre-commit and the Claude hook, not a pre-commit framework `entry:`.
